notes.title: Version 1.0.1.5 Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The "Change Clothes" window will now appear after the "Makeover" window upon starting a new save file.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1.4 Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the crafting button to not work after attempting to continuously craft certain items.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused meals to have an incorrect sprite when using uncommon or rare meat and fish. This fix will NOT affect previously created meals!
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1.3 Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Certain items in the crafting menu will continually craft items while clicked. Items that behave this way are: arrows, bait, spiles, and metals.
[*] Added a line of text in the tutorial to explain how to continually craft items.
[*] Spiles are now crafted in batches of 3 and their stack limit has been increased from 1 to 15.
[*] Increased the amount of experience gained from firemaking.
[*] Increased the chance of plants dropping 2 seeds.
[*] Clarified the rarity of fish in the fishing guide.
[*] A different line of dialogue will be displayed when lower-level arrows and bait fail.
[*] Animals and fish no longer spawn immediately upon loading a save file.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1.2 Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused prospecting for gold to not work.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1.1 Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Tool power has been re-balanced: weaker tools will work more effectively on higher-level objects, while stronger tools will work less effectively on lower-level objects. The efficiency of tools used on equal-level objects has been left unchanged.
[*] Added text to the tutorial explaining how to light a fire.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1.0 Notes
notes.content:
The first major content update is here! This update focuses primarily on expanding the hunting and fishing skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465368/509a4945436ed862a7b149959125ae163c5707f3.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added new variations of animals and fish.
[list]
[*] For animals, each individual species (squirrel, turkey, deer, boar, and elk) has a possibility of being three different colors (common, uncommon, and rare) for a total of 15 animals.
[*] For fish, each shadow size (small, medium, large, huge, and monster) has a possibility of being three different species (common, uncommon, and rare) for a total of 15 saltwater fish and 15 freshwater fish.
[*] The original 5 animals and 5 fish from the game are common, while the new ones are uncommon and rare.
[*] Rarer variations of animals and fish will make better meals; the cooking quality of rare beginner-level meat is equivalent to common apprentice-level meat, while uncommon meat is halfway between common and rare meat.
[*] Rarer variations of animals and fish will yield more hunting and fishing experience.
[/list]
[*] The hunting, fishing, and cooking skill guides have been updated.
[*] Gold now has a rare chance of dropping 2 or 3 pieces when prospected.
[*] A new action has been added for farming and firemaking which requires pressing the left mouse button while the oscillating indicator is at the center of the gauge.
[*] Three new achievements have been added.
[list]
[*] Hunting Master: Kill a rare animal.
[*] Fishing Master: Catch a rare fish.
[*] Honest Work: Harvest 30 crops.
[/list]
[*] The maximum amount of ores that can be extracted from deposits has been increased from 3 to 5, and the minimum has been increased from 1 to 3.
[*] Lowered the amount of metals required to upgrade your home.
[*] Lowered the experience gained from mining salt deposits.
[*] Lowered the experience gained from smelting.
[*] Clarified some text in the tutorial.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.3 Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Weaker effects of meals and elixirs will no longer replace stronger effects that the player currently has.
[*] Plants have been reworked so that seedlings have "Water" as their first option and fully grown plants have "Harvest" as their first option.
[*] Plants now have a chance of dropping 2 seeds when harvested.
[*] Increased the amount of inventory space in furniture by 12 (you will have to rebuild furniture to see this change).
[*] Decreased the amount of experience gained from smelting by 25%.
[*] Changed the icon of the executable file.
[*] Fixed a water rendering issue that caused the dark ripples to not appear at the edge of the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.2 Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Crafting ingredients for certain items and furniture have been reworked so that higher-level resources can be used in place of lower-level resources.
[*] Reduced the amount of swings required to chop trees and mine deposits by 50%. Experience rates have been modified to accommodate.
[*] Reduced the amount of swings required to ignite fires and plant seeds by 33%.
[*] Deposits that only dropped 1 ore will now drop a random range of 1 to 3 ore(s).
[*] Reworked and increased the percentages and durations of effects.
[*] Clarified some text in the tutorial.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.1 Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Disabled left-click movement while performing an action (fishing, logging, moving furniture, etc). This will hopefully prevent the stopping of an action accidentally by left-clicking outside of the circular area.
[*] Music will play more frequently. The minimum time between songs has changed from 5m to 4m, and the maximum time between songs has changed from 15m to 12m.
[*] The Steam achievement "Welcome to the Island" is now rewarded when the final tutorial message is displayed, rather than when it is closed.
[*] Effect percentages will no longer display an unnecessary decimal point.
[*] Effects that increase your experience have now been doubled.
[/list]
